concreteRepairs: R03 raised terrain triangles intruded across the wet right curb and around the veranda footstone. The circulation reservation now extends beyond actual slabs/curb/footstone/rail apron by more than a .25m grid diagonal. Actual adjoining cell vertices remain at y=-.22. The outside creek rise blends over .62m instead of making an abrupt raised lip.

R03 deep hall undercroft and 22 near-identical tall rock pedestals retired. A closed battered retaining terrace with six bonded courses, 129 individually sized face stones, full cap, short stone bearings, continuous timber joists and nine actual embedded diagonal gallery brackets now supports the hall. R04 flush heavy frontage was rendered, rejected and retained; R05/R06 setback gives real depth beneath the gallery.

Four hall stair bearings now sit on closed .94m pads from worldY-.24 to+.04, joined to actual piers, crossheads, inclined stringers and tread bed. Low approach cheek stones are exactly cut where the slope intersects a course, eliminating the previous omitted triangular start. Bridge lower trim is seated on the actual carrying rib.

Finite creek reflection uses the actual irregular basin outline and real scene geometry at water level. R05 genuine bank crop exposed a clamped false bright patch. R06 mirrors horizontal off-axis projection on private reflection source cameras for both scene-local horizontal reflection layers and synchronizes inverse projection. Physical cameras unchanged; recursive capture prevented.
